mapper.select: SELECT LEVEL, C.* FROM (SELECT COMMENT_NO_BOARD, COMMENT_CONTENT_BOARD, TO_CHAR(COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD, BOARD_NO, MEMBER_NO, WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME ,BUSINESS_NICKNAME, MEMBER_NAME , PARENT_COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}) C WHERE ( COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = C.COMMENT_NO_BOARD AND COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N') ) AND (BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' OR BUSINESS_NICKNAME IS NULL) START WITH PARENT_COMMENT_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENT_NO_BOARD = PARENT_COMMENT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY COMMENT_NO_BOARD
